title: Workout of the day and the Plus lock switch have no test of any kind
what: The Workout of the day card and the Plus lock switch in Settings are not opened by any unit test or any browser test, so a change that breaks them would pass every check.
expected: Each owner screen is opened by at least one test that checks what it shows and saves.
fix_line: Add one browser test each that opens the screen, saves a change and checks the result

title: The only quick tests of several owner screens look for words in the code, not at what the screen does
what: Training progress, Member questions, Settings, Today and the member receipt are checked by quick tests that read the screen's code as text and look for set phrases. A rename passes or fails them with no change in what the owner sees.
expected: Quick tests open the screen and check what it shows.
fix_line: Replace the text checks with tests that open the screen and check what it shows

title: When the rewards count on Today cannot be read, the old number stays and nothing says so
what: If reading the 'rewards to give' count fails, the failure is only written to the browser log. Today keeps showing the last number it had, or nothing, with no hint that it is out of date.
expected: A failed read clears the count or says it could not be checked.
how_often: when the internet or server drops
fix_line: On a failed read, hide the count or show that it could not be checked
